title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) — Patronage Tax Reporting and Donation Options by Class
content:
# Patronage Tax Reporting and Donation Options by Class

Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) payouts are reported to the IRS and may be donated according to the class terms below.

| Patron class | Payouts reported on IRS Form 1099-PATR | Smallest calendar-year payout reported | Backup withholding where no taxpayer identification number is on file | Donation of payouts allowed | Accepted donation recipients |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Patron Class | No | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |
| Seasonal Patron Class | No | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |
| Farm Patron Class | Yes | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |
| General Service Patron Class | Yes | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |
| Irrigation Patron Class | Yes | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |
| Large Power Patron Class | Yes | $10.00 | 24 percent | Yes | Operation Round Up; Scholarship Fund |

## Desk notes on the table

- Residential and Seasonal Patron Class payouts are not reported on Form 1099-PATR; the threshold column is listed for every class but has effect only where reporting is required.
- In the Farm, General Service, Irrigation and Large Power Patron Classes a member's payouts are reported once the member's calendar-year payouts in the class reach $10.00.
- Only Operation Round Up and the Scholarship Fund are accepted as donation recipients, in every class.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Class | Member's calendar-year payouts | Reported on Form 1099-PATR |
|---|---|---|
| Irrigation Patron Class | $9.99 | No |
| Irrigation Patron Class | $10.00 | Yes |
| Seasonal Patron Class | $340.00 | No — the class does not report |
